approval.prompt: The export passed geometry, firing-anchor, and sampled motion checks. No additional credits were used. Do the repaired geometry and three Motion clips—walk, run, backward—look right before I add materials?
approval.scope: Exact repaired geometry and three draft motion clips as the basis for materials and runtime work.

limitations: Authoring-time candidate status strings are preserved for exact reproduction; this external approval is authoritative for the scoped visual decision.
Piston stroke, exhaustive collision, runtime/gameplay appearance and hardware performance acceptance remain separate.
